weapon.description: Exact catalogue name, as returned by weapon-lookup's `resolved`.

affinity.description: One of the thirteen affinities. The valid list is enforced by a precondition, not here, so a wrong one refuses with the list rather than being rejected as malformed.

upgrade.description: Upgrade level. The 0-25 range is a precondition; the weapon's own cap is checked by a postcondition, because a contract cannot read the weapon table.

max_upgrade.description: This weapon's upgrade cap, copied from weapon-lookup. Optional, but pass it: with it an over-cap upgrade is a refusal you can act on; without it the same mistake is only caught after the fact, as a defect.

two_hand.description: Two-handing multiplies effective strength by 1.5. Default false.

ignore_require.description: Skip the penalty for unmet requirements. Default false. Use it to see a weapon's potential, never to answer what a build hits for today.

status_buff.description: A status-buff item or spell name, e.g. 'Frozen Armament'. Default 'None'.
